comparison.objective: Fit a separate key and keyed pulley onto a freely rotating shaft, versus set and lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2037 counterholds a shaft while placing a key, phase-aligning a pulley keyway, and sliding the pulley home; the candidate counterholds an adjustment screw while tightening its concentric jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2037 requires key seating, pulley insertion to the shoulder, release, and one-second stillness; the candidate requires nut locking and repeated retained-angle cycles.
comparison.reason: Counterholding is shared, but keyed multi-part alignment and insertion are meaningfully different from preserving a continuous setting under tightening torque; no task.json spec was available, but the PR body provides the full staged rubric.
